feeds.title: Tabby Dietitian Blog
feeds.description: Tabby provide you with personal advice, allowing you to plan and make the right choices for your new and healthy future. She is an experienced and friendly state registered private dietitian working for 30 years to help you with:- weight loss,diabetes,bowel disorders, food and mood and healthy eating.

feeds.title: Dietitian's Life
feeds.description: We are UK registered dietitians who have a similar enthusiasm for all things dietetic and ensuring the right nutritional messages are getting out there. Dietitians are registered with the Health Care Professions Council and must adhere to a code of conduct, ensuring we give evidence-based nutritional advice.

feeds.title: Nics Nutrition
feeds.description: I'm a UK Specialist Registered Dietitian (RD). I have a passion for promoting easy to understand nutrition and diet tips. My aim is to motivate and inspire YOU to lead a healthier and subsequently happier life, one step at a time through my nutrition blogs, healthy lifestyle tips and recipes, and healthy product reviews.
